response.sql: WITH type_counts AS (SELECT o.ordertune, COUNT(DISTINCT o.orderspivot) AS executed_order_count FROM orderexecutions AS e JOIN orders AS o ON o.recordvault = e.ordersmark GROUP BY o.ordertune), shares AS (SELECT executed_order_count, CAST(executed_order_count AS REAL) / SUM(executed_order_count) OVER () AS share FROM type_counts), compared AS (SELECT executed_order_count, share, AVG(share) OVER () AS average_share FROM shares) SELECT SUM(executed_order_count) AS total_count, AVG(share) AS average_share, AVG(share - average_share) AS average_excess_share FROM compared WHERE share > average_share;

assumptions.assumption: An executed order is a distinct order with at least one matching execution; each order counts once even if it has multiple executions.

alternatives.interpretation: Count execution records by order type, so multiple executions of one order count multiple times.
alternatives.sql: WITH type_counts AS (SELECT o.ordertune, COUNT(*) AS execution_count FROM orderexecutions AS e JOIN orders AS o ON o.recordvault = e.ordersmark GROUP BY o.ordertune), shares AS (SELECT execution_count, CAST(execution_count AS REAL) / SUM(execution_count) OVER () AS share FROM type_counts), compared AS (SELECT execution_count, share, AVG(share) OVER () AS average_share FROM shares) SELECT SUM(execution_count) AS total_count, AVG(share) AS average_share, AVG(share - average_share) AS average_excess_share FROM compared WHERE share > average_share;
